topicName: Good, Evil and the Causes of Crime

questions.question: Explain two religious teachings about the causes of crime.

points.text: 1) Christianity teaches that crime results from free will and original sin — humans choose to do evil rather than good. However, Christians also recognise social causes of crime such as poverty, inequality and lack of opportunity.
